name: Lorena (Brazil)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a white fleur-de-lis over a black cross of Lorraine.
history: Lorena is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag, designed by Ricardo Gomes Figueira, was prescribed by Municipal Law No. 507 of 9 August 1965 and inaugurated on 14 November 1966: red and white are the colours of Bernardo José de Lorena, Count of Sarzedas, who granted the town its status and name, the fleur-de-lis evokes Our Lady of Piety and the cross of Lorraine the Christian faith.
